data.title: Slepý vrch at Orešany – the educational trail completed
data.excerpt: On 24 July 2016 Lukáš Ilavský of our Hradiská civic association, together with Matúš Sládok of the Regional Monuments Board in Trnava and other volunteers, completed the educational trail leading up to the Celtic hillfort of Slepý vrch. Waymarkers and handsome wooden panels now take visitors from the centre of Dolné Orešany straight to the 2,500-year-old hillfort.

children.text: On 24 July 2016 Lukáš Ilavský, a member of our Hradiská civic association, in collaboration with Matúš Sládok (the Regional Monuments Board in Trnava) and other volunteers in the village of Dolné Orešany, completed the educational trail leading to the Celtic hillfort of Slepý vrch. Along the route of the trail they placed waymarkers which take those interested from the centre of the village straight to the hillfort.

Half of the handsome wooden panels were made by our member Patrik Pohanka. The other half was made from his design by Lukáš Ilavský. We trust that every walker will now have no trouble in locating the 2,500-year-old Celtic hillfort of Slepý vrch.
